author: TEDx Talks
description:
Making friends is one of the most important life skills a person can have, yet we're rarely taught how to actually do it. Designer Jenn Maer shows us how to use a methodology called  "Design Thinking" in order to make friends or deepen existing friendships. You still need to be brave and take the initiative, but using this method has the potential to make things a whole lot easier. Jenn Maer is a designer, creative director, writer, and friendship ambassador. 

This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: How to use design thinking to make new friends | Jenn Maer | TEDxAsheville

author: TEDx Talks
description: What if winning is not only found on the scoreboard? Carl Bradfield explores the habits, routines and behaviours that shape sustainable high performance, drawing from cricket, coaching and human development. He shows why athletes, teams and leaders perform better when they focus on presence, ownership, balance and what is important now. A titan of South African domestic cricket, Carl Bradfield’s professional career is defined by over 5,000 first-class runs and nearly a decade of leadership with the Eastern Province Warriors. Today, he is widely regarded as one of the country’s most meticulous schoolboy coaches, renowned for a disciplined, pedagogical approach that extracts the very best from young athletes. Beyond technical mastery, Carl focuses on the character of the game, guiding young men to reach their full potential both on and off the field. A mentor and strategist with a profound understanding of the foundations of success. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED con
title: Redefining the Win beyond Invisible scoreboards | Carl Bradfield | TEDxHilton

author: TEDx Talks
description: What if every community had a school that stood as a lighthouse of hope, safety and possibility? George Harris argues that education systems built on fear, regulation and compliance can suppress creativity and ownership. He proposes a different model , one that rewards progress, gives schools greater autonomy and empowers communities to shape learning around the needs of their children and local context. George Harris is the Headmaster of Hilton College, a role he approaches with deep-seated optimism and a commitment to stewardship. His career has spanned both rural and urban education, including the transformative experience of establishing Lebone II for the Royal Bafokeng Nation. A Klingenstein Fellow of Columbia University and a Fellow of the Africa Leadership Initiative (ALI), George is deeply committed to the promise and potential of young people. He finds inspiration in the cultural richness of Africa, literature, and the natural world. This talk was given at a TEDx event using
title: Reimagining Education Through Incentive | George Harris | TEDxHilton

author: TEDx Talks
description: Chris Pappas explores how communities move from decline to renewal through three distinct phases: disruption, stabilisation and momentum. Drawing on the realities of rebuilding public institutions, he shows why lasting progress depends less on dramatic announcements and more on consistency, trust, reliable systems and thousands of disciplined decisions made over time. Chris Pappas is the Mayor of the uMngeni Local Municipality and a dedicated advocate for transparent, service-driven governance. A Hilton College alumnus with a background in Town and Regional Planning, Chris previously worked as a development economist before entering public service. His transformative approach to local leadership earned him a place on the 2023 TIME100 Next list, recognizing him as a rising global leader. Born and raised in the Midlands, Chris is passionate about unlocking the economic potential of the region while building a resilient, collaborative future for all its residents. This talk was given at
title: Stability Becomes Momentum and Momentum Changes Everything. | Chris Pappas | TEDxHilton

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Denim Richards explores what it will take for Africa’s creative talent to grow into sustainable, globally competitive industries. He invites audiences to see African creativity not simply as cultural expression, but as a powerful source of long term economic value, highlighting the role of commercial intelligence, infrastructure and ownership in shaping the continent’s future in entertainment.
 Denim Richards is a Hollywood Actor and Filmmaker with more than two decades in the Entertainment Industry and over 40 credits across Theatre, Television, and Film. He is widely known for the role of Colby Mayfield alongside Kevin Costner on the #1 hit television series Yellowstone. Beyond acting, he is also serving as the Ambassador to Botswana and the Director for Media, Arts and Culture and within the African Union. With this, Mr. Richards is advancing opportunities and creating pathways for African Artisticpreneurs to thrive on the Global Stage. Denim Richards is the CEO of Opulent Entertai
title: Africa Is Not the Footnote. It Is the Frontier. | Denim Richards | TEDxHilton

author: TEDx Talks
description: Professor Bonang Mohale reflects on leadership, democracy, inequality and Africa’s unfinished promise. Drawing from his personal journey and the themes behind his autobiography Coming in from the Cold, he challenges audiences to stop outsourcing society’s biggest questions to politicians and institutions, and to make them personal. His talk is a call for ethical leadership, shared responsibility and the courage to leave South Africa better than we found it. Professor Bonang Mohale is the Chancellor of the University of the Free State and a Professor of Practice at the Johannesburg Business School. A towering figure in South African industry, he serves as Chairman of The Bidvest Group and ArcelorMittal, and was recently appointed as the Sherpa for the Values 20 (V20), advising the G20 on human centered  policy. The best-selling author of Lift As You Rise, Professor Mohale is a globally recognised advocate for ethical leadership and economic transformation. His lifelong commitment to me
title: The Big Questions Must Become Personal | Prof Bonang Mohale | TEDxHilton

author: TEDx Talks
description: You are a fish convinced you belong in a lesser river, and Samantha knows exactly how that feels. Drawing on her experience as a young fencer, she explores the psychology of self-deception and how the stories we tell ourselves, fed by comparison, social media and selective memory, quietly shape what we believe we are capable of. The good news: you have a pen, and you get to choose which story you write. Hello, my name is Samantha. Currently, I’m in grade 9, I’m from Malaysia, and has lived here my entire life. TedX This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: The Story You Tell Yourself | Samantha Chua | TEDxIGBIS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: Sitting in class overhearing classmates talk about their futures, Inaya realised she had no idea what she wanted, and that feeling of being left behind is something she argues is deeply misunderstood. Drawing on the psychology of social comparison and the neuroscience of how our brains process progress, she makes the case that feeling behind is not evidence that you are failing. It is just evidence that you are human. Hi! My name is Inaya Zia, and I’m a Grade 9 student studying at IGBIS. Growing up in a society where comparison and achievement were everywhere, I became truly interested in the psychology of why people feel like they are “behind” in life even when they are doing just fine. I decided to join Ted-X because I knew I could create a lasting impact because of its power to shift perspectives and start meaningful conversations. My goal is to remind people that progress isn’t linear and that everyone moves through life at their own pace. By understanding the reasoning behind thi
title: You Are Not Late | Inaya Zia | TEDxIGBIS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: At 11:47 p.m., scrolling through someone else's highlight reel, Si Xuan did not just feel unmotivated; she felt defective. Drawing on the science of neuroplasticity, she unpacks how the stories we tell ourselves while comparing our lives to others quietly shape what we believe we are capable of. Your mindset, she argues, is not your confidence level; it is the lens you can choose to change. Hello! My name is Si Xuan, and I am currently a Grade 9 student at IGBIS. It is my first year at IGB doing the IB programme, so everything is a new experience for me. However, when I discovered that TEDx was available at IGB, I knew I wanted to participate because of the impact it has on people. My goal is to change the way individuals perceive themselves in a world that often encourages self-doubt, especially through social media. Through my speech, I hope to offer a different perspective and remind the audience not to compare themselves to others, as each person is unique and special in their own
title: You Are Not Behind | Si Xuan Chan | TEDxIGBIS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: Four letters can feel like a revelation, but Hyeyoon asks whether they have quietly become an excuse. Drawing on a moment when a friend called her out for hiding behind her personality type, she makes a sharp case for why MBTI should explain you rather than excuse you. Your personality, she argues, is not your destiny; it is just your starting point. Hi! My name is Hyeyoon and I’m in grade 9. I’m Korean and was born in Korea but lived most of my life in Türkiye. I just moved to Malaysia around 3 years ago. As a kid, I was very introverted. My parents were even called to school because I didn’t speak to anyone and didn’t even answer in class. That’s why I wanted a change. I wanted to speak up. Stop being shy and stop getting red everytime people look at me. And that’s why I joined TedX youth. Speaking of being introverted, my speech is about MBTI. My experience as an introvert. What I realised after some hard years. So, come see my speech. I really hope you enjoy it! This talk was give
title: You Are Not Your MBTI | Hyeyoon Jang | TEDxIGBIS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: Wanting to change and being ready for it are not the same thing, and Julie learned that the hard way at 5 a.m. staring at her ceiling. Her talk makes a simple but compelling case that real change does not start with big effort but with habits so small they seem almost embarrassing. Do them anyway, she argues, because small habits are not just what you do; they are how you become who you want to be. Hi, my name is Julie and I am currently a grade 9 student. I am Korean and I came to Malaysia to study three years ago. Before, I have been in a Korean government school. I came to IGBIS last year, and I wanted to try new things which is why I decided to do TedX Youth. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Small Habits, Big Change | Juwon (Julie) Lee | TEDxIGBIS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Happiness is not a finish line you cross after enough achievements, and Ellie has a different way of thinking about it entirely. Using the metaphor of Lego blocks, each representing something different like purpose, rest, friendship and even failure, she makes the case that happiness is something you build yourself, in your own way. There is no single definition, and that is exactly the point. Hello, my name is Ellie and I am a grade 9 student. I am from Korea, but I have lived in China for 5 years and Malaysia for 5 years as well.
This year is my first year in IGB, so I wanted to try a new experience, which was TedX Youth. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Happiness | Ellie (Jiyul) Lee | TEDxIGBIS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: Your eyeballs can elongate, your skull has weak spots, and your brain is held up by something less sturdy than a coconut tree, and yet here you are, fully functioning. Jolene makes a sharp, funny, and surprisingly convincing biological case for why humans are literally designed with flaws, and why that means your failures are not a personal shortcoming but simply part of being alive. So what are you going to do about it? Hi, I’m Jolene from Grade 12 and I’m Vietnamese but no one would know that at the first glance because I was raised in Malaysia and can most definitely use “lah” correctly. Contrasting with my chronic social anxiety, one of my passions is making speeches at 4 am fueled by my many shower thoughts at 3 am such as how I can tell my friends to stop putting themselves down for the nth time without screaming at them. My other passion is human anatomy if you didn’t get that from listening to my speech… This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but i
title: You Are Meant to Fail | Jolene (Dung Tinh) Nguyen | TEDxIGBIS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the symbol of success we’ve trusted for generations… has quietly inaccessible and unmanageable?

In this thought-provoking TEDx talk, real estate strategist Jagan Mohan Reddy challenges one of the world’s oldest and most respected wealth systems—the traditional property deed. For decades, owning property has meant stability, pride, and financial security. But in a fast-moving, digital-first world, he asks a powerful question: Why does real estate still move at the speed of paper?

Blending real-world insights with sharp economic perspective, Jagan reveals the hidden inefficiencies that make real estate one of the most valuable—yet inaccessible and illiquid—asset classes today. From rising affordability gaps to the “all-or-nothing” ownership model, he uncovers why even smart global investors often avoid real estate, calling it “too messy.”

Through compelling stories and simple analogies, he introduces the concept of *Real Estate 3.0*—a shift from rigid, paper-based ownership t
title: Real Estate 3.0: From Paper Ownership to Programmable Wealth | Jagan Mohan Reddy K | TEDxVCOE

author: TEDx Talks
description: Failure does not disappear, but it can stop controlling you. Drawing on the story of explorer Ernest Shackleton, who came agonisingly close to his dream only to watch someone else claim it first, Jeonseo makes a compelling case for why perseverance is not about avoiding failure but learning to face it. The thin line between success and failure, he argues, is crossed not by talent but by refusing to stop. Hi, my name is Jay and I’m 12 years old. I was born in Korea, but lived in New Zealand most of my life. I have been on many different trips to different countries with my family. I love to travel, experiencing new and diverse cultures, and learning more about each country's traditions. Another thing I love to do is playing sports and doing outdoor activities. Skiing, tennis, football, swimming and even playing on trampolines are my favourite things to do. My TedX is about “Overcoming fear of failure.” I joined TedX because I wanted to experience how it felt to be on stage, telling a c
title: Fear of Failure | Jeonseo (Jay) Kang | TEDxIGBIS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
The talk explores practical ways to repair disagreements and rebuild connections, drawing on the idea that conflict is a normal part of everyday life. The speakers believe that learning how to respond to conflict matters, because it affects friendships, families and communities. A Year 9 student from the United States, Avery is interested in how people can handle conflict more positively. In his talk, he explores practical ways to repair disagreements and rebuild connection, drawing on the fact that conflict is a normal part of everyday life. He believes that learning how to respond to conflict matters because it affects friendships, families, and communities. Outside of school, he enjoys spending time with friends, playing sports, and listening to music.

A Year 10 student from England who has spent most of her life in Asia, Livvy interested in how people navigate and resolve conflict. In her talk, she explores practical ways to manage disagreements calmly and rebuild relationships,
title: The Three Sentences That Fix Almost Anything | Avery Hung & Olivia Swift | TEDxYCYW Shanghai Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: This is a short talk about a student’s experience of depression, and how we can slowly shift from feeling stuck in the present to striving for tomorrow. It draws on personal experience, explores change, and encourages the audience to look ahead. 'Constance Kwok is a year 10 Hong Kong student in Mainland China, Shanghai Puxi. She experiences depression and is a pessimistic person, viewing the world in a different way. Yet, she still tries to be optimistic and is making progress on her journey. On this journey, she knows the struggle to experience depression yet trying to step out of it. Determined with hope and sheer will, she is on a journey to navigate her way through it. She wishes to share the experiences and encourage that life perhaps isn't that bad and you just need to slowly make small adjustments. One step at a time, and overcome it together. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at http
title: Striving for Tomorrow, Overcoming Depression | Constance Kwok | TEDxYCYW Shanghai Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: Riddi’s talk explores the idea that the most powerful force in the world is not authority, status, or influence—but a ripple. Through personal stories of setbacks, delayed opportunities, failed internships, and a transformative question asked during a call home — “What were the people who succeeded doing differently?” — she shares a simple yet life-changing approach to leadership: How can I make a difference? From organizing student initiatives to engaging with policymakers and global platforms, Riddi reflects on how small actions can create impact far greater than ourselves. Drawing on thinkers like James MacGregor Burns and examples such as Greta and Malala, this talk challenges traditional views of leadership and reminds us that leadership is not about titles; it is about the difference we choose to make. She is an educationist and entrepreneur, and the founder of Generation Purple, an edtech platform that empowers students with career clarity and character education through truste
title: The Secrets of Leading Early | Riddi Viswanathan | TEDxGoodShepherdIntlSchool

author: TEDx Talks
description: Kirti focuses on how small, courageous decisions can gradually transform both our inner lives and external paths. Through personal stories of adventure, injury, recovery, and endurance, she illustrates how seemingly minor choices—like trying something new or adapting after setbacks—can lead to unexpected growth and opportunities. The talk reframes challenges as turning points rather than obstacles, emphasising resilience, self-compassion, and presence. By highlighting how individual actions can inspire others in unseen ways, Kirti ultimately encourages the audience to take simple, intentional steps forward, showing that meaningful change often begins with one small, brave decision. Kirti is an AI Strategy Lead at British Telecom and a mother to an eight-year-old, seamlessly balancing leadership with elite endurance sport. An accomplished endurance athlete and mountaineer, she has completed three Super Randonneur series—200, 300, 400, and 600 km rides—and is the only woman in India to
title: What Trying Leaves Behind | Kirti Chalam | TEDxGoodShepherdIntlSchool

author: TEDx Talks
description:
This talk explores the idea that human potential is not fixed, but developed through continuous learning and personal growth. True “profitability” as a human being comes from investing in oneself through education, discipline, and the willingness to step outside of one’s comfort zone.

It challenges the audience to rethink growth as an active process—one that requires courage, commitment, and constant preparation. Ultimately, it is an invitation to embrace discomfort as a necessary path toward becoming a better, more capable version of ourselves. Carmen Gaxiola is a Human Development Consultant with extensive experience in administrative leadership across service, commercial, and construction sectors. Her work integrates financial, operational, and compliance strategies with a strong focus on human capital as a driver of organizational performance.

She is CEO of CAP Consultores, where she leads projects in human development and corporate training, designing programs that strengthen l
title: La rentabilidad del ser humano | Carmen Gaxiola | TEDxMesa de Otay Women

author: TEDx Talks
description: Peer pressure often works invisibly, not as direct force but as a quiet whisper pushing us to fit in. Drawing from the Asch Conformity Experiment, the talk explains how even obvious truths are abandoned to avoid standing out—a survival instinct from ancient times. Using real-life examples like students abandoning passions to follow friends, the speaker emphasizes that most people are equally uncertain. The solution is simple but brave: pause and ask, "Am I choosing for myself or for others?" True independence means reclaiming control over your own choices, interests, and story. A Grade 8 student, demonstrates remarkable talents and a wide range of interests. She excels academically, showing a strong passion for languages and a growing curiosity about psychology and how it influences daily decision-making. Beyond her studies, Dorah is a skilled dancer in Chinese traditions and a talented singer who expresses herself through pop music. Her combination of intellectual curiosity, artistic
title: Choosing Yourself in the Crowd: How Peer Pressure Shapes Us | Dorah Yu | TEDxWAIS Hangzhou Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Not everyone inherits a path. Some of us have to build it—and that is precisely what makes it meaningful. This talk is a call to action for those who have had to create their own way forward. It reflects on the power of individual decisions and how real change begins when an ordinary person chooses to act. Every time a woman becomes the first to do something, she makes it possible for others to follow. No matter your story or where you come from, you have the ability to open new paths. Because the world does not change when we find our place in it—it changes when we create space for someone else. Elisa Ibañez is a Certified Public Accountant specializing in Social Security and Human Capital, with over 34 years of experience in payroll taxation and employee benefits. She is a partner in the Human Capital Tax practice at Mauricio Monroy Contadores.

Her work includes conducting social security and housing fund audits, advising companies across multiple sectors, and developing employee b
title: Si nadie te entregó un camino: atrévete a construirlo | Elisa Ibañez | TEDxMesa de Otay Women

author: TEDx Talks
description:
This TEDx talk explores how women are breaking barriers in the craft beer industry in Tijuana, a field long dominated by men. Through a personal story, it shares the journey of building a brewery from the ground up, facing stereotypes, challenges, and doubt, while proving that passion, preparation, and perseverance can open spaces where it once seemed impossible.

Beyond beer, this talk reflects on leadership, resilience, and the importance of challenging societal expectations. It is about turning obstacles into opportunities, honoring inherited knowledge, and inspiring others to believe in their ability to transform industries, communities, and their own stories. Ximena López is an entrepreneur, cultural promoter, and a leading voice in the evolution of craft beer in Baja California. Raised in Tijuana, she grew up in a family where beer was more than an industry—it was a way to build community and identity. In 2013, she co-founded Azteca Craft Brewing, and after her father’s passing,
title: Las puertas no siempre abren: a veces se construyen | Ximena López | TEDxMesa de Otay Women

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Many women appear successful on the outside, yet internally they are still operating in survival mode. This talk reveals why true leadership is not about doing more, but about transforming from within and no longer sustaining life from a place of exhaustion. An invitation to rise, step out of survival, and begin leading with clarity, intention, and personal power. Lorena Almaraz is a trainer and coach focused on personal development and women’s leadership. Her work centers on guiding women to align their mindset, skills, and inner structure in order to build sustainable businesses and lead with clarity and purpose.

Through her programs, conferences, and the National Women in Business Congress, she has supported the transformation of hundreds of women across diverse professional fields. Her approach integrates strategy, self-awareness, and emotional development, positioning her as a voice that emphasizes the real and lasting impact of female leadership in society. This talk was given
title: El liderazgo que nace cuando dejas de sobrevivir | Lorena Almaraz | TEDxMesa de Otay Women

author: TEDx Talks
description:
如果我告訴你一個幾乎不需要成本的方法，就可以讓員工 「動起來!」你有興趣嗎?
高階經理人御用顧問張敏敏指出，員工面對變動時需要的不是緊繃與命令，而是一個能說服他們「為什麼要改變」的理由與滿滿的希望感 。四個步驟: 訊息管理、同理心、好理由及展現決心，形成有層次的溝通節奏，讓員工甘心為大局做出改變，攜手迎接未來的挑戰。

張敏敏，JW智緯管理顧問公司總經理，中華OGSM目標管理協會理事長、HBR繁體中文版專欄作家領導影響力學院 變革執行力總顧問 Ming-Ming Chang General Manager, JW Management Consulting Chairperson, Chinese OGSM Objectives Management Association Columnist, Harvard Business Review Traditional Chinese Edition Chief Advisor for Change Execution, Leadership Influence Academy

This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: 希望感是改變的動力 Hope drives change | 張敏敏 Ming-Ming Chang | TEDxYongkang

author: TEDx Talks
description:
“Kum Saatini İzlerken” başlıklı bu konuşmada Canan Arın, akademisyen, yazar ve öncü kadınlardan biri olan Nermin Abadan Unat'ın yaşam öyküsünden yola çıkarak zamanın, mücadelenin ve toplumsal değişimin izlerini sürüyor. Bir yaşam hikâyesi üzerinden kadınların kamusal alandaki varlığını, bıraktıkları mirası ve kuşaklar arası aktarımın önemini ele alıyor. 1942’de Ankara’da doğan Arın, İstanbul Kız Lisesi’nin ardından İstanbul Üniversitesi Hukuk Fakültesi’ni bitirdi. Londra Ekonomi Okulu’nda anayasa hukuku üzerine çalıştıktan sonra 1976’da Türkiye’ye dönerek avukatlığa başladı.
1980’lerden itibaren kadın hareketi içinde aktif rol alan Arın; Mor Çatı Kadın Sığınağı Vakfı, KA.DER ve İstanbul Barosu Kadın Hakları Uygulama Merkezi’nin kuruluşunda yer aldı. Avrupa Konseyi ve BM bünyesinde de görevler üstlendi.
Kırk yılı aşkın feminist mücadelesiyle kadın hakları alanına önemli katkılar sağlayan Arın, 2021’de Anne Klein Kadın Ödülü ve Hrant Dink Ödülü’nü aldı; çalışmalarını İstanbul’da sürdürm
title: "Kum Saatini İzlerken" | Canan Arın | TEDxITU Women

author: TEDx Talks
description:
“İyileşirken iyileştirmek” fikrinden yola çıkan bu konuşmada Dr. Sare Aydın, psikiyatri alanındaki deneyimleriyle birlikte iyileşmenin yalnızca bireysel bir süreç olmadığını; temas ettiğimiz insanlara da dokunan karşılıklı bir dönüşüm olduğunu ele alıyor. İnsan zihninin kırılganlığı ve dayanıklılığı üzerinden, iyileşme sürecinin hem hekim hem de birey için nasıl çok katmanlı bir deneyime dönüştüğünü anlatıyor. Sare Aydın, doğuştan paraplejik olarak dünyaya geldi. Evde kendi çabasıyla okuma yazmayı öğrenerek sınıf atlayan Aydın, lise eğitimini birincilikle tamamladı. Tokat Gaziosmanpaşa Üniversitesi Tıp Fakültesi’nden bölüm birincisi olarak mezun oldu; TUS’ta 15.000 aday arasında 136. oldu. Psikiyatri uzmanlığının ardından 2025’ten itibaren Tokat Gaziosmanpaşa Üniversitesi Tıp Fakültesi Ruh Sağlığı ve Hastalıkları Anabilim Dalı’nda Doktor Öğretim Üyesi olarak görev yapmaktadır.
Ulusal ve uluslararası dergilerde makaleleri ve kongre bildirileri bulunan Aydın, üniversitelerde farkındalık
title: İyileşirken İyileştirmek | Dr. Sare Aydın | TEDxITU Women

author: TEDx Talks
description:
“Bir kalp atımı kadar ince bir çizgi” üzerinden hekimliğin sorumluluğunu ve insan hayatının kırılganlığını ele alan bu konuşmada Zahide Küçük, kadın sağlığı alanındaki hekimlik deneyimlerinden yola çıkarak tıbbın sadece bilimsel bir süreç değil; aynı zamanda derin bir insan hikâyesi, karar anları ve etik sınavlar bütünü olduğunu anlatıyor. Yaşam ile ölüm arasındaki hassas dengeyi ve bir jinekolog olarak tanıklık ettiği insan deneyimlerini izleyiciyle paylaşıyor. lise eğitimini Ankara’da tamamladıktan sonra 2007 yılında Erciyes Üniversitesi Tıp Fakültesi’nden mezun oldu. 2014 yılında Ankara Eğitim Araştırma Hastanesi’nden Kadın Hastalıkları ve Doğum Uzmanı unvanını aldı. Ankara Gölbaşı Hasvak Devlet Hastanesi’nde zorunlu hizmetini tamamladıktan sonra özel hastane deneyimi kazanarak kendi kliniğini kurdu.
Kadın sağlığı, yüksek riskli gebelik takibi ve jinekolojik ameliyatlar alanlarında uzmanlaşan Küçük, “Sağlıklı gebelik, sağlıklı çocuk, sağlıklı yarınlar” ilkesiyle hareket ederek tüm
title: Bir Kalp Atımı Kadar İnce Bir Çizgi Hekimlik | Op. Dr. Zahide Küçük | TEDxITU Women

author: TEDx Talks
description: “Ya yıldızlar bize ulaşabilseydi?” sorusundan yola çıkan bu konuşmada Esra Özkan, bakış açımızı tersine çevirerek hayata, insana ve kendimize dair anlam arayışımızı yeniden düşünmeye davet ediyor. Ulaşmak istediğimiz şeylerin aslında bize ne kadar yakın olabileceğini sorgularken, umut, merak ve içsel keşif üzerinden yeni bir perspektif sunuyor. Esra Özkan, yapay zekâ, dijital ve medya sanatları alanında uzman bir küratör, kültür yöneticisidir, akademisyendir. Londra ve New York’ta yaşadığı süre boyunca kariyerinde önemli araştırma projeleri yürütmüş, güncel olarak da Dubai  Kültür ve Sanat Otoritesi'nde Dijital Sanat Danışmanı olarak görev yapmakta ve teknoloji ile sanat arasında güçlü bağlar kurarak Dubai’nin yaratıcı ekosistemine uluslararası ölçekte katkı sağlamaktadır. Sanat Yönetimi, Felsefe ve Toplumsal Düşünce alanlarında lisans yapan Esra Özkan, güncel olarak  Golden Gate Universitesi, San Francisco’da Generatif Yapay Zekâ odaklı Emerging Technologies alanında Doktora (DBA) ça
title: Ya Yıldızlar Bize Ulaşabilseydi | Esra Özkan | TEDxITU Women

author: TEDx Talks
description: Yıldızlara ulaşmak için ihtiyacımız olan şey gerçekten dışarıda mı, yoksa zaten içimizde mi saklı? Bu konuşmada Sevil Akı, bireyin kendi potansiyelini keşfetme yolculuğunu, kalbinin sesini dinlemenin önemini ve herkesin içinde taşıdığı kişisel hazinenin dönüştürücü gücünü ele alıyor. Kendi özüne yaklaşmanın, hayallere ulaşmanın ve yaşamda anlam bulmanın anahtarlarını izleyicilerle paylaşıyor. Sevil Akı, 1991 yılında Müjdat Gezen Sanat Merkezi’nin ilk açıldığı yıl tiyatro bölümüne girerek 1995’te ilk mezunlar arasında yer aldı.Mezuniyetinin ardından kurucuları arasında yer aldığı E.S.E.K Tiyatro Topluluğu’nda sahneye çıktı.1997’de Ferhan Şensoy’un daveti üzerine Ortaoyuncular ekibine katılarak Ferhan Şensoy, Tuncel Kurtiz ve Baykal Kent gibi ustalarla çalıştı.2000 yılında İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyesi Şehir Tiyatroları bünyesine katılan Akı, Siyah Beyaz Renkli Tiyatro, Ekip Tiyatrosu ve Kumbaracı50 gibi özel tiyatrolarda da sahneye çıkmaya devam etti.Şehir Tiyatroları’ndaki Tiyatro Ha
title: Yıldızlara Ulaşmanın Sırrı, Kalbimiz ve Kişisel Hazinemizde Saklı | Sevil Akı | TEDxITU Women
